entries.jp: この技が戦況を優位にするぞ
entries.en:
This move will turn the
battle in our favor!

entries.jp: 技発動！戦況が有利なるぞ！
entries.en:
Move activated! The tide
turns our way!

entries.jp: 今こそ敵全体に連携攻撃だ！
entries.en:
Now, a combo attack
on all enemies!

entries.jp: 連携攻撃で、敵全体に攻撃だ
entries.en:
A combo attack on
all the enemies!

entries.jp: 武器に込めた怒り、味わえ！
entries.en:
Taste the wrath
I've poured into my weapon!

entries.jp: 武器召喚！この攻撃を食らえ！
entries.en:
Weapon summon!
Take this attack!

entries.jp: われと控えの式神と交代せよ！
entries.en:
Swap me with a
reserve shikigami!

entries.jp: われと控えの式神を交代せよ！
entries.en:
Swap me out for a
reserve shikigami!

entries.jp: 空間変化で攻撃力上昇を狙え
entries.en:
Shift the field to
raise our Attack!

entries.jp: 苦しいが、弱音ははけぬ
entries.en:
It's hard, but
I won't complain.

entries.jp: 敵と刺し違えても負けぬ！
entries.en:
Even if I fall with the foe,
I won't lose!

entries.jp: 体力の限界まで戦ってやろう
entries.en:
I shall fight to the limit
of my strength.

entries.jp: われは最後まであきらめないぞ
entries.en:
I shall never give up,
not until the very end.

entries.jp: 指示の適確さが勝敗に関わるぞ
entries.en:
Precise orders decide
whether we win or lose.

entries.jp: 体力が少ない。慎重に動こう
entries.en:
My HP is low.
Let us move with care.

entries.jp: 体力は少ないが、大丈夫だ
entries.en: My HP is low, but I am fine.

entries.jp: 体力は減ったが、まだ戦える
entries.en:
My HP has dropped,
but I can still fight.

entries.jp: 体力はある！指示を出すのだ
entries.en:
I have HP to spare!
Give your orders!

entries.jp: 体力はある。今は攻めるのみ！
entries.en:
I have HP to spare.
Now we attack, nothing else!

entries.jp: 体力はまだある。ＳＰを溜めよ
entries.en:
I still have HP.
Build up your SP.

entries.jp: 体力のことなら心配無用だ
entries.en: Have no fear for my HP.

entries.jp: 敵の力が上昇している
entries.en: The enemy's power is rising.

entries.jp: わが属性は火！変えてほしい
entries.en:
My element is Fire!
I would have it changed.

entries.jp: 空間が敵が有利だ。対応たのむ
entries.en:
The field favors the enemy.
Deal with it, I ask you.

entries.jp: 空間を別の属性に変えるのだ！
entries.en:
Change the field to
another element!

entries.jp: 上昇した雷火の力を見よ！
entries.en:
Behold my risen
power of Thunderfire!

entries.jp: 上昇した我が力、無敵なり
entries.en: My risen power is invincible.

entries.jp: この火こそわが力の源
entries.en:
This fire is the source
of my power.

entries.jp: よし！火の力はわれに有利だ
entries.en:
Good! The power of Fire
is in my favor!

entries.jp: 雷火の名に恥じぬ戦いをしよう
entries.en:
Let us fight in a manner worthy
of the name Thunderfire.

entries.jp: われは決してあきらめぬ
entries.en: I shall never give up.

entries.jp: あきらめるな！希望はまだある
entries.en:
Do not give up!
There is still hope!

entries.jp: この翼折れるまで戦ってみせる
entries.en:
I shall fight until
these wings break.

entries.jp: 控えと交替することはできるか
entries.en:
Can I swap with
my reserve?

entries.jp: 入れ替えで翼を休ませたい
entries.en:
I wish to swap out
and rest my wings.

entries.jp: 入れ替えで体力の回復が必要だ
entries.en:
I need to swap out
and recover my HP.

entries.jp: ここは一度退いたほうがいいな
entries.en:
Best to fall back
for now, I think.

entries.jp: さあっ今こそ指示を頼む！
entries.en:
Now, give me
your orders!

entries.jp: 今だ！連携攻撃でとどめを指せ
entries.en:
Now! Finish them
with a combo attack!

entries.jp: 今だ！この機を逃すな！
entries.en:
Now! Do not let
this chance slip!

entries.jp: 今だ！わが技でとどめを指せ！
entries.en:
Now! Finish them
with my move!

entries.jp: １分たった！本気を出すぞ！
entries.en:
One minute is up!
I fight in earnest now!

entries.jp: １分たった！火の属性にせよ！
entries.en:
One minute is up!
Make the field Fire!

entries.jp: １分たった！連携攻撃を狙え！
entries.en:
One minute is up!
Go for a combo attack!

entries.jp: １分たった！決着をつけよう！
entries.en:
One minute is up!
Let us settle this!

entries.jp: 連携攻撃で敵を追いつめるのだ
entries.en:
Corner the enemy
with a combo attack.

entries.jp: わが武器は手槍で攻撃する
entries.en: My weapon is a hand spear.

entries.jp: わが技は敵に雷を落とす！
entries.en:
My move calls lightning
down upon the foe!

entries.jp: 火の属性で攻撃力が上がるぞ
entries.en:
A Fire field raises
my Attack!

entries.jp: 相殺で行動を封じられたぞ
entries.en:
The clash has sealed
my action!

entries.jp: 相殺で敵の攻撃を封じたぞ
entries.en:
The clash has sealed
the enemy's attack!

entries.jp: 相殺で敵の行動を封じたぞ
entries.en:
The clash has sealed
the enemy's action!

entries.jp: われにお任せあれ！
entries.en: Leave it to me!

entries.jp: わが力を使う時がやってきたか
entries.en:
Has the time come to
use my power?

entries.jp: この戦いで勝利をもたらせよう
entries.en:
I shall bring victory
in this battle.

entries.jp: ついにわが出番がやってきたか
entries.en: At last, my turn has come.

entries.jp: われを召喚したことに感謝する
entries.en:
I am grateful that
you summoned me.

entries.jp: この翼折れるまで戦ってやろう
entries.en:
I shall fight until
these wings break.

entries.jp: われは天の雷火　いざ勝負
entries.en:
I am the Thunderfire of Heaven.
Have at thee!

entries.jp: 召喚されたからには　必ず勝つ
entries.en:
Now that I am summoned,
I will surely win.

entries.jp: われらの連携　驚いたか？
entries.en:
Did our combo attack
surprise you?

entries.jp: われらの連携にひるんだか？
entries.en:
Did our combo attack
make you flinch?

entries.jp: われらの連携は無敵なり！！
entries.en:
Our combo attack
is invincible!!

entries.jp: われらの連携　思い知ったか！
entries.en:
Now you know the power
of our combo attack!

entries.jp: わが技で地獄に落ちよ！
entries.en: Fall to Hell by my move!

entries.jp: 天地の怒り　その身に受けよ！
entries.en:
Receive the wrath of
Heaven and Earth!

entries.jp: わが雷火の技にひれ伏すがよい
entries.en:
Bow down before my
Thunderfire move!

entries.jp: わが雷火の技　とくと味わえ！
entries.en: Savor my Thunderfire move!
